idea-plugin.name: Cloudflared Runner
idea-plugin.description:
Runs cloudflared quick tunnels and Access clients from a tool window instead of a terminal tab.

  • Quick tunnel — cloudflared tunnel --url <target>. The route column shows the local service and the generated trycloudflare.com hostname.
  • Access client — cloudflared access tcp --hostname <host> --url <bind>. The route column shows the Access hostname and the local listener it opens.
Output is streamed into a per-connection console, so login prompts and auth URLs stay visible. Running processes are killed when the project closes.

Requires cloudflared on PATH, or an explicit path per connection. The plugin does no Cloudflare API calls and handles no credentials — cloudflared does its own authentication.
